_about: Street barks for 月湾 Moonbay (js/peds.js plays them through js/samples.js). Original lines, no real or game-series names. node tools/tts.mjs --barks [--force] renders every line in the voices listed under 'say' -> audio/barks/<cat>_<n>_<voice>.mp3 + manifest.json.

mO.speaker: en_male_tim_uranus_bigtts
mO.hint: a man in his late sixties, a little gravelly

bump.mood: Annoyed, muttered at someone who just bumped into you on the sidewalk. Short and natural, not theatrical.

gunpoint.mood: Terrified, shaky, pleading quietly with someone pointing a gun at you.
lines: My hands are up! See? They're up!
I didn't see your face, I swear.

flee.mood: Panicked, shouting while running away from gunfire, out of breath.
lines: Oh my God, oh my God!
Where do I go? Where do I go?

film.mood: Excited and a bit breathless, filming something wild on your phone, talking half to the phone.
lines: Oh, I'm getting all of this.
Are you guys seeing this right now?
Hold on, hold on. I'm live.

road.mood: An impatient driver yelling out of the car window, irritated, loud.

near.mood: Startled and angry, a car nearly hit you, shouting after it.

push.mood: Squaring up, angry, someone just shoved you.
lines: You wanna do this? Let's do this.

say: line n goes to one male voice (mY, mA, mO by n mod 3) and one female voice (fY, fA, fO by (n + 1) mod 3); 'road' skips the old voices for the young adult ones
